facility_summary: Seoul's signature light festival lighting up the Cheonggyecheon and Gwanghwamun area
facility_description: Held every autumn, the Seoul Lantern Festival lights up Cheonggyecheon Stream and Gwanghwamun Square with a rainbow of lanterns. Traditional lantern craft blends with modern media art, making nighttime viewing especially beautiful. A signature nighttime festival popular with families and couples alike.
extra_info: Some programs may be canceled in case of rain

facility_name: National Museum of Korea Special Exhibition: Treasures of Joseon
facility_summary: A special exhibition bringing together royal artifacts and national treasures from the Joseon dynasty
facility_description: Curated by the National Museum of Korea, this special exhibition of Joseon royal artifacts displays around 150 precious pieces, including 20 National Treasures. Artifact descriptions are provided in four languages: Korean, English, Japanese, and Chinese.
extra_info: Advance booking recommended, on-site tickets available
fee: Adults 5,000 KRW, Teens 3,000 KRW, Children free

facility_summary: Seoul's largest fireworks festival, held at Yeouido Hangang Park
facility_description: Seoul's biggest fireworks festival, held every October at Yeouido Hangang Park. Fireworks teams from Korea and abroad put on a dazzling show lasting about an hour. Over a million visitors attend this signature autumn festival each year.
subway_info: Line 9 National Assembly Station Exit 1, 10-min walk
extra_info: Heavy traffic expected on the day, public transit recommended

facility_summary: A handmade market by artists, held on Hongdae Walking Street
facility_description: A free market held every Saturday on Hongdae Walking Street. Emerging artists and craftspeople sell handmade accessories, artwork, and small goods. Busking performances also take place, making it a beloved weekend outing spot.
subway_info: Line 2 Hongik Univ. Station Exit 9, 5-min walk
extra_info: Canceled in case of rain, participating artists change weekly

facility_summary: A cultural event bringing together brand pop-up stores and food trucks across Seongsu-dong
facility_description: A pop-up store festival held across Seongsu-dong. Well-known Korean and international brands open limited-run pop-up stores with a variety of experience programs. Food trucks, DJ performances, and photo exhibitions round out a lineup full of things to enjoy.

facility_summary: A limited spring/autumn special night-viewing program at Gyeongbokgung Palace
facility_description: A night-opening program held only in spring and autumn each year at Gyeongbokgung Palace. The illuminated palace grounds create a mysterious mood completely different from daytime. Tickets are available by advance reservation only and each session sells out quickly.
